gaps.sentence: She's a leading ___ (SCIENCE) in climate research.
He gave me some very useful ___ (ADVISE).
gaps.explanation: 'Advice' is uncountable — never 'advices'; 'advise' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (LONG) of the film is 145 minutes.
gaps.explanation: 'The length' — noun from long (spelling change: long → length).
'A tendency to do something' — noun from tend.

gaps.sentence: The storm caused ___ (WIDE) damage along the coast.
gaps.explanation: 'Widespread damage' = damage across a large area.

gaps.sentence: The project's ___ (FAIL) was due to poor planning.
The bridge has a maximum ___ (WEIGH) of ten tonnes.
The shop is under new ___ (MANAGE) from Monday.
